title: StudySyndicate Multimodal Media Contract
purpose: Make image, audio, and video reusable first-class media nodes that can be attached to prompts, answers, explanations, mnemonics, and context while remaining local-first, portable, integrity-checked, and accessible.

factoredModel.principle: Binary payloads never live inside prompt, response, concept, or relationship records.

voiceNode.note: Generated speech stores reproducibility metadata but never credentials, API keys, or provider secrets.

usage.principle: The same media node may be reused by multiple cards or concepts through separate uses-media relationships.

accessibility.audioSpeech: spoken audio carries a text transcript so the card remains reviewable without sound
accessibility.preferenceModel: support modality preferences and context without assigning a fixed learning-style identity to the learner

acceptanceContract.statement: Audio, image, and video are first-class reusable media actors rather than nested binary blobs.
A spoken-audio media node can preserve transcript, language, origin, integrity metadata, and generated-voice provenance without storing secrets.
Prompts, responses, concepts, and other study actors attach media through uses-media relationships with an explicit role and learning mode.
A full media bundle carries study.json, manifest.json, and integrity-addressed binary assets and can be validated before import.
Bundle import can deduplicate identical binary assets by SHA-256 while preserving stable media node identifiers.
Spoken audio requires a transcript and meaningful images require alt text unless explicitly decorative.
